        - '.ppt.'
        - '.pptx.'
        - '.jpg.'
        - '.pdf.'
filter:

        - '\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Office\Recent\'

condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: Add office filter
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.lnk'
    TargetFilename|contains:
        - '.doc.'
        - '.docx.'
        - '.xls.'
        - '.xlsx.'
        - '.ppt.'
        - '.pptx.'
        - '.jpg.'
        - '.pdf.'
filter_recent:
    TargetFilename|contains:
        - '\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Office\Recent\'
        - '\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Windows\Recent\'
filter_excel:
    Image|endswith: '\excel.exe'
    TargetFilename|contains: '\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Excel'
filter_powerpoint:
    Image|endswith: '\powerpnt.exe'
    TargetFilename|contains: '\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\PowerPoint'
filter_word:
    Image|endswith: '\winword.exe'
    TargetFilename|contains: '\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Word'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: TargetFilename="*.lnk" TargetFilename IN ("*.doc.*", "*.docx.*", "*.xls.*", "*.xlsx.*", "*.ppt.*", "*.pptx.*", "*.jpg.*", "*.pdf.*") NOT (TargetFilename IN ("*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Office\\Recent\\*", "*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Recent\\*") OR (Image="*\\excel.exe" TargetFilename="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Excel*") OR (Image="*\\powerpnt.exe" TargetFilename="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\PowerPoint*") OR (Image="*\\winword.exe" TargetFilename="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Word*"))
